method: Personally read full USGS PDF pages 1–2 and full OS PDF pages 8–10 through pypdf extraction plus all five existing complete page images. No fetch or duplicate PDF. pypdf font warnings resolved for relevant text by image inspection.

grounds.exactLocator: PDF p.1, Large Is Small, first two paragraphs (Simply defined...; These representative fraction scales...)

grounds.exactLocator: PDF p.1 opening paragraph, The proportion chosen... / Selecting the appropriate scale...
grounds.claim: Appropriate scale depends on sheet size and accurate placement of features.

grounds.exactLocator: PDF p.1 last paragraph continued at p.2 first paragraph, Footbridges, drawbridges, fence lines, and private roads...
grounds.claim: These features are shown at 1:24,000 in the cited USGS description. Footbridges means пешеходные мосты, not броды.

grounds.exactLocator: PDF p.8 Grid references and 4-figure map references; p.9 full diagrams/examples 1845,1945,1844,1944
grounds.claim: Eastings first, northings second; northings increase upwards/northward; four figures identify a kilometre square by its bottom-left corner.

grounds.exactLocator: PDF p.10 National Grid lines, complete two paragraphs and National Grid diagram
grounds.claim: A two-letter prefix identifies a 100-km square; numeric references repeat in other squares; NX is shown and used in the example NX 509582.
